settings.sticker: Every sale helps Detroit rescue dogs

settings.heading: A girl and her dogs
settings.text:
Welcome to Rescue Retro Relics — a shop born from love, loss, and the unbreakable bond between a girl and her dogs. In 2021, during the chaos of COVID, I adopted Bailee, my soul dog — a beautiful, prestigious Plott Hound who completely changed my life. She pulled me through some of my darkest days and gave me three years of pure joy. We lost her in April 2024 to cutaneous lymphoma at just 8 years old. It shattered me, but I know she wouldn't want me to stop. The day she crossed the Rainbow Bridge, she sent me Savannah — a sweet mini version of her who needed me as much as I needed her. A few months later came Casey, a mama from a puppy mill who didn't know how to be a dog. Savannah taught her how to play, and Casey taught Savannah how to love other dogs.

Now, with my talented 15-year-old daughter Bella by my side, my life is dedicated to saving as many dogs as possible. From multi-state rescue transports and networking fosters to fundraising and donating — every spare minute goes toward giving back the love Bailee gave me.

I am my own boots on the ground. I'm not affiliated with any single rescue organization — I don't do this to prop up any one group, I do it to save dogs, full stop. I'm out there myself: transporting dogs out of Detroit and Ohio, networking to find fosters for dogs at risk, picking dogs up out of animal control with my own hands, my own gas money, and my own time. I'll help any legitimate rescue that needs it, no allegiance required, just a shared goal of saving lives.

settings.image_alt: Bailee, Savannah and Casey together in Rescue Retro Relics bandanas
settings.heading: The eternal dog
settings.text:
I love Snoopy because he’s the eternal dog — timeless, always there through the decades with that classic attitude every dog seems to have a little of. I started Rescue Retro Relics to share my Snoopy finds (and all the other nostalgic treasures) with fellow collectors while helping fund vet bills, food, and whatever our local rescues need. What began with Snoopy has grown into brand-new retro cartoon and pop culture inspired collectibles, stickers, Re-Ment, and so much more, with true vintage finds coming soon — all the things that make you smile and remember the good old times.

I’ve been selling on eBay since late 2025, and now I’m here on my own shop too, so I can offer a bigger selection at better prices for my customers.

settings.heading: Shop With Confidence
settings.text:
Every item is honestly described and photographed by me. I’m passionate about authenticity and connecting collectors with pieces they’ve been searching for.

💛Thank you from the bottom of my heart for every visit, share, and purchase. Every single one helps give another sweet pup a chance at the best life — just like Snoopy.

🍀 Céad Míle Fáilte — a hundred thousand welcomes. We’re so glad you’re here. 🐾 Have a question or looking for something specific? Get in touch — we’d love to help.

My Sweet Bailee Beans, until we meet again 💜🐾
